Messages.Author: Mirumo
Messages.Body:
Set's Curse
Type: Action
Requires: Serpentis
Cost: 2 blood
+1 stealth action.
[ser] (D) Burn any ally or retainer to put this card into play. This
card becomes an animal ally with 3 life, 2 strength and 0 bleed. This
ally cannot have or use equipment or retainers and cannot play action
cards.
[SER] As above, but burn a vampire with capacity less than 3 to put
this card in play.

My question is about the cost of the ally created by this card. It's 2
blood or 0 ?

Messages.Author: Salem
Messages.Body:


I'd guess that it's absolute cost was 2, but it's _recruit_ cost was 0,
as it wasn't recruited.

but that seems weird.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


It's an action card, not an ally card. The cost printed on the card is there
action's cost.

The ally it becomes has a cost of zero.
